Ito ay dagdag na bayad na required ng ba: It is extra pay required by law (PD 851) for rank-and-file employees in the private sector. It is not a gift or a company bonus: it is your right if you worked at least one month during the year.
Kausapin muna ang HR o payroll. Kung hin: Talk to HR or payroll first. If it is not resolved, go to the nearest DOLE Regional or Field Office, or call the DOLE Hotline 1349. You can also file a Request for Assistance under the Single Entry Approach (SEnA).
Lahat ng rank-and-file employees sa priv: All rank-and-file employees in the private sector, whether regular, probationary, contractual or casual, as long as they worked at least one month in the calendar year, however they are paid. Kasambahay are also covered under RA 10361. Government employees have their own year-end bonus, and managerial employees are not covered by PD 851, though they may have a benefit under their contract or company policy.

Oo. Ang leave without pay, tardiness o u: Yes. Leave without pay, tardiness or undertime deducted from your salary is not part of “basic salary earned”, so your 13th month pay goes down too. Paid leave, such as paid vacation or sick leave, does not reduce it because you were still paid.
Oo. Required ng batas ang 13th month pay: Yes. 13th month pay is required by law. A Christmas bonus depends on the company, unless it is written in your contract or CBA, or has become regular practice. But both share the same ₱90,000 tax exemption.
